catalogue.description: Explicit plane realizations of the elliptically admissible extension orbits at the natural Halphen index. Each entry records a coefficient field, a smooth plane cubic, the complete ordered cluster of nine centers, and the classes of the prime (-2)-curves in the basis (L,E_1,...,E_9).
catalogue.theorem: For each of the twenty-six entries, blowing up the displayed ordered cluster gives an extremal Halphen surface of the stated index and extension orbit; the displayed class-matrix rows are the classes of unique geometrically integral (-2)-curves and form the declared affine ADE configuration.
catalogue.exclusion: The split D6+2A1 extension is absent because its middle group is (Z/2)^3, which cannot be a subgroup of a smooth elliptic curve; the two nonzero extension orbits are represented.

sections.tex:
Inside \(t(t-1)(2t-1)(8t^2-8t+1)\ne0\), remove the closed locus
where the points collide or one of the ten unique root curves ceases to be
geometrically integral.  The remaining open is nonempty, as certified by
\(t=2\).

sections.label: Cubic
sections.tex:
Set
\[
\Delta=a^2bc-2abc+ac+a+bc-2c-1
\]
and
\[
\begin{aligned}
h_1&=-a^3b^2c+3a^2b^2c-a^2b-3ab^2c+abc+2ab+b^2c-2bc-b+c+1,\\
h_2&=-a(a-2)(bc-c-1),\\
h_3&=-a^2b^2c+2ab^2c-abc-ab-b^2c+2bc+b-c-1,\\
h_4&=a(a^3b^2c-2a^2b^2c+a^2b+ab^2c-ab-ac-a+2c+2),\\
h_5&=a^2bc(a-2),\qquad h_6=ab\Delta.
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
G=\mathscr G(h_1,h_2,h_3,h_4,h_5,h_6,-ah_6).
\]

sections.label: Normal and extension
sections.tex: The class $N=\mathcal O_G(3)-\sum_i p_i$ has exact order $4$. The middle group $\langle p_i-p_1\rangle$ is $\mathbb Z/16$; its quotient by $\langle N\rangle$ is $\mathbb Z/4$, and the extension class is the cyclic orbit $\xi=\pm1$.

sections.label: Field and parameters
sections.tex:
Let \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{other}\,2}\) be the normalization of
\(\Phi_{\mathrm{other}\,2}(s,t)=0\). Put
\[
k=\mathbb Q(\Gamma_{\mathrm{other}\,2}).
\]
On \(G=0\), the class \(p_6-p_1\) has exact order \(4\).\\
Constant field &
The polynomial $\Phi_{\mathrm{other}\,2}$ is irreducible over $\mathbb Q$.  The algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q$ in $k$ is $\mathbb Q(i)$; over this field the polynomial has two conjugate absolutely irreducible factors of total degree $5$.

sections.label: Cubic
sections.tex:
$\begin{aligned}
g_{1}&=s t \left(s - 1\right) \left(s - t\right) \left(t - 1\right),\\
g_{2}&=- s \left(s - t\right) \left(s^{2} t - 3 s t + s + t^{2}\right),\\
g_{3}&=- t \left(s - 1\right) \left(t - 1\right) \left(s t - 2 t + 1\right),\\
g_{4}&=s^{3} + 2 s^{2} t^{3} - 4 s^{2} t^{2} - s^{2} t - 4 s t^{3} + 12 s t^{2} - 6 s t + s - 2 t^{2} + t,\\
g_{5}&=s \left(s - 1\right) \left(s^{2} t - 2 s t^{2} + 3 t^{2} - 3 t + 1\right),\\
g_{6}&=\left(s - t\right) \left(t - 1\right) \left(s t - 2 t + 1\right),\\
g_{7}&=- \left(s - 1\right) \left(s - t\right) \left(s t - 2 t + 1\right),\\
G&=\mathscr G(g_1,\ldots,g_7).
\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}
g_{1}&=u \left(u - 2\right) \left(s u^{2} - 2 s u + 2 s - u^{2} + u\right),\\
g_{2}&=- u \left(u - 1\right) \left(s u^{2} - 3 s u + 3 s - u^{2} + 2 u - 1\right),\\
g_{3}&=- \left(u - 2\right) \left(u - 1\right) \left(s u^{2} - 2 s u + 2 s - u^{2} + u\right),\\
g_{4}&=s u^{4} - 6 s u^{3} + 14 s u^{2} - 14 s u + 6 s - u^{4} + 5 u^{3} - 10 u^{2} + 8 u - 2,\\
g_{5}&=\left(u - 1\right) \left(s u^{2} - 3 s u + 3 s - u^{2} + 2 u - 1\right),\\
g_{6}&=\left(s - 1\right) \left(u - 2\right) \left(u - 1\right)^{2},\\
g_{7}&=- \left(u - 1\right) \left(s u^{2} - 3 s u + 3 s - u^{2} + 2 u - 1\right),\\
G&=\mathscr G(g_1,\ldots,g_7).
\end{aligned}$
